defsZh:
n. 禮貌, 謙恭, 好意
[法] 優待, 禮貌, 恩惠

examples.en: "Exchanging courtesies every day is all we've done," Tom answered with resignation.
examples.zh: “天天寒暄就是我們做的所有事了。”湯姆無奈地回答。

examples.en: Show a little courtesy!
It's a common courtesy.

defsEn: a courteous or respectful or considerate act

defsZh: n. 創造力, 創造性

examples.en: Creating creativity itself is improving creativity.
examples.zh: 創新創新本身就提升了創新。

examples.en: Creativity is the key.
His creativity ran out.

defsEn: the ability to create

defsZh:
n. 不合, 爭論, 不一致
[法] 不一致, 不同意, 陪審團的意見不一

examples.en: Jim sometimes has disagreements with his wife.
examples.zh: 吉姆有時與他的妻子意見分歧。

examples.en: It's clear that there's a rather strong disagreement between the two.
examples.zh: 很明顯的是這兩者之間有很強烈的分歧。

examples.en: They express disagreement by shaking their heads, which may indicate agreement in other countries.
examples.zh: 他們以搖頭表示不同意，而其他國家的人可能以搖頭表示同意。

defsEn: a conflict of people's opinions or actions or characters

defsZh: n. 失望

examples.en: What a disappointment!
examples.zh: 多麼讓人失望啊！

examples.en: Tom couldn't conceal his disappointment.
examples.zh: 湯姆不能掩飾他的失望。

examples.en: The new teacher was a disappointment to the class.
examples.zh: 新老師辜負了這個班學生的期望。

defsEn: a feeling of dissatisfaction that results when your expectations are not realized

defsZh: vt. 使感覺不滿, 不滿足

examples.en: If you're so dissatisfied with what I'm doing, you'd be better off doing it yourself.
examples.zh: 你要是這麼不滿意我做的，自己來做好了。

examples.en: I was quite dissatisfied.
Why are you dissatisfied?

defsEn: fail to satisfy

defsZh: a. 可從中得到樂趣的, 令人愉快的

examples.en: I had an enjoyable two weeks in London.
examples.zh: 我在倫敦度過了愉快的兩週。

examples.en: This photograph reminds me of enjoyable times when I was a child.
examples.zh: 這張照片讓我想起童年的快樂時光。

examples.en: I feel like somehow I've stopped thinking of translation as something enjoyable.
examples.zh: 不知怎麼的，我覺得翻譯好像已經不再是一件樂事了。

defsEn: affording satisfaction or pleasure

defsZh:
n. 才能, 能力, 全體教員, (大學的)系
[醫] 能力, [大學]院系

examples.en: I study comparative religion in the arts faculty of the University of Turku.
examples.zh: 我在圖爾庫大學文化系學習宗教比較學。

examples.en: Tom is my faculty advisor.
What faculty were they in again?

defsEn: one of the inherent cognitive or perceptual powers of the mind

defsZh: a. 有利的, 讚許的, 良好的

examples.en: Circumstances are entirely favorable to us.
examples.zh: 環境完全對我們有利。

examples.en: His comments about the book were favorable.
examples.zh: 他給這本書正面的評價。

examples.en: Thanks to the favorable wind, we soon reached the island.
examples.zh: 多虧了順風，我們很快就到了那個小島。

defsEn: encouraging or approving or pleasing

defsZh:
n. 領班, 工頭, 陪審長
[經] 領班, 工頭

examples.en: Ziri is a foreman.
Tom is the foreman.
Tom was our foreman.

defsEn: a person who exercises control over workers

defsZh:
n. 論壇, 公開討論的廣場, 法庭, 討論會
[法] 討論會, 專題討論, 公共論壇

examples.en: I do not have an account in these forums.
examples.zh: 我在這些論壇上沒有帳號。

examples.en: This forum is great.
Tom attended the forum.

defsEn: a public meeting or assembly for open discussion

defsZh:
n. 創立者, 建立者
vt. 使沉沒, 使摔倒, 弄跛, 浸水, 破壞
vi. 沉沒, 摔到, 變跛, 倒塌, 失敗

examples.en: She is not the founder, she's the investor.
examples.zh: 她不是創辦人，她是投資人。

examples.en: In the center of the university campus stands the statue of the founder.
examples.zh: 創校人的雕像在大學校園的中心矗立著。

examples.en: The founder died two months ago.

defsEn: inflammation of the laminated tissue that attaches the hoof to the foot of a horse

defsZh: n. 募捐

examples.en: He's also in charge of fundraising.
Tom is organizing a fundraising event.
He was in charge of the fundraising efforts.

defsEn: raise money for a cause or project

defsZh:
n. 製圖法, 製圖學, 圖解演算法, 圖形顯示
[計] 圖形; DOS外部命令:列印圖形方式下的螢幕內容

examples.en: The graphics keep glitching out.
Tom installed graphics mods for his game.
Your laptop's graphics card is top-notch.

defsEn: photographs or other visual representations in a printed publication

defsZh:
a. 便利的, 敏捷的, 容易取得的
[化] 便於使用的; 易操作的

examples.en: That's very handy.
examples.zh: 這很方便。

examples.en: It really comes in handy.
examples.zh: 這真的能派上用場。

examples.en: She's handy with a needle.
examples.zh: 她擅長針線活。

defsEn: United States blues musician who transcribed and published traditional blues music (1873-1958)

defsZh:
a. 危險的, 冒險的, 碰運氣的
[法] 危險的, 冒險的, 碰運氣的

examples.en: This is extremely hazardous.
This is a hazardous workplace.
Lead is hazardous to human health.

defsEn: involving risk or danger

defsZh: n. 醫療保健；衛生保健；健康護理, 健康服務

examples.en: Gunter worked in healthcare.
Is there healthcare in Hell?
Do you have a healthcare proxy?

defsEn: the preservation of mental and physical health by preventing or treating illness through services offered by the health profession

defsZh:
n. 溼氣, 潮溼, 溼度
[計] 溼度

examples.en: The humidity is down.
I can't stand humidity.
The humidity is very high.

defsEn: wetness in the atmosphere

defsZh: a. 有影響的, 有勢力的

examples.en: He has a lot of influential friends.
examples.zh: 他有很多具有影響力的朋友。

examples.en: Tom and Mary think John isn't influential.
examples.zh: 湯姆和瑪莉認為約翰沒有影響力。

examples.en: He's very influential in the world of medicine.
examples.zh: 他在醫學界有很大的影響力。

defsEn: having or exercising influence or power

defsZh:
a. 全國性的
[法] 全國的, 全國範圍的

examples.en: He had got nationwide fame.
The Kremlin moved to extend the lockdown nationwide.
Implementing this nationwide was no simple endeavor.

defsEn: occurring or extending throughout a country or nation

defsZh:
n. 填補, 襯墊, 印色盒, 路
vt. 填補, 走, 誇大
vi. 步行
[計] 焊接點; 包裝配/拆卸

examples.en: May I use your ink pad?
examples.zh: 可以借你的印臺一用嗎？

examples.en: Is this maxi pad for overnight use?
examples.zh: 這是夜用的衛生巾嗎？

examples.en: I am so exhausted because I have padded the hoof for 4 hours.
examples.zh: 走了四個小時，我覺得非常累了。

defsEn: a number of sheets of paper fastened together along one edge

defsZh:
n. 釋義, 解述, 改寫
vt. 改寫, 解述
vi. 釋義, 意譯

examples.en: Sami is paraphrasing here.
I don't understand this word. Could you paraphrase it?
I'm surprised by AI's ability to paraphrase and analyze novel sentences.

defsEn: rewording for the purpose of clarification

defsZh:
n. 放置, 佈置, 工作安排, 編班, 定位球
[計] 放置

examples.en: There's a placement test next week.
The show is full of product placement.
I cheated on my Berber placement test.

defsEn: the spatial property of the way in which something is placed

defsZh:
a. 郵政的, 郵局的
[經] 郵政的

examples.en: What is a postal code?
Tom is a postal worker.
Tom worked as a postal worker.

defsEn: of or relating to the system for delivering mail

defsZh:
n. 名聲, 宣傳, 公開場合
[經] 宣傳, 廣告

examples.en: You don't have to worry about publicity.
examples.zh: 你不用擔心宣傳的事。

examples.en: It was a publicity stunt.
This job pays in publicity.

defsEn: a message issued in behalf of some product or cause or idea or person or institution

defsZh:
n. 承租人, 佃戶, 出租人
[經] 租賃人, 租戶, 出租人

examples.en: Yanni is an evicted renter.
It'll be easy to find a renter for this house.
I am now a member of the local association of renters.

defsEn: someone who pays rent to use land or a building or a car that is owned by someone else

defsZh: n. 修理工
adv. 重複地, 再三地

examples.en: I'm tossing and turning, repeatedly thinking about what happened today, deeply remorseful.
examples.zh: 我輾轉反側，反覆思考著白天發生的事，後悔不已。

examples.en: I can't believe you are eating something the doctor has told you repeatedly you shouldn't eat.
examples.zh: 真的不敢相信你在吃醫生叮囑不要食用的東西。

examples.en: Tom kicked Mary repeatedly.

defsEn: several time

defsZh: n. 洗手間；休息室；更衣室；廁所

examples.en: Where's the restroom?
examples.zh: 廁所在哪裡？

examples.en: She's in the restroom.
examples.zh: 她在上廁所。

examples.en: May I go to the restroom?
examples.zh: 我可以去洗手間嗎？

defsEn: a toilet that is available to the public

defsZh: adv. 默默地, 靜靜地

examples.en: Tom sat silently for 30 minutes.
examples.zh: 湯姆靜靜地坐了半個小時。

examples.en: Tom watched Mary silently.
Tom silently shut the door.

defsEn: without speaking

defsZh:
n. 礦泉, 溫泉浴場, 礦泉治療地
[計] 軟體出版者協會

examples.en: I hit on a spa.
James has a spa.
Spa is a spa town.

defsEn: a health resort near a spring or at the seaside

defsZh:
n. 空白表格程式, 電子製表軟體, 電子資料表
[計] 電子表格

examples.en: You cannot put this into an Excel spreadsheet.
Do you have experience working with spreadsheets?
The link to your spreadsheet has invalid characters.

defsEn: a screen-oriented interactive program enabling a user to lay out financial data on the screen

defsZh:
n. 主要物產商, 把羊毛分級的人, 訂書機
[經] 主要商品批發商

examples.en: Will you please lend me a stapler?
examples.zh: 請你借給我一支訂書機好嗎？

examples.en: Is that a stapler?
Yanni has a stapler.

defsEn: a machine that inserts staples into sheets of paper in order to fasten them together

defsZh:
n. 流線, 流線型
vt. 使成流線型, 使合理化

examples.en: Our curriculum is very streamlined.
The manufacturing process has been streamlined.
Tom is constantly streamlining his business plan.

defsEn: contour economically or efficiently

defsZh: adv. 實質上, 本質上, 大體上

examples.en: Can Algeria reduce its unemployment rate substantially?
Algeria will need to increase its interest rates substantially.
The stability of Chinese economy is substantially overestimated.

defsEn: to a great extent or degree

defsZh:
n. 敘述者, 講故事者, 出納員
[經] 出納員

examples.en: Ziri is a teller.
Ziri became a teller.
Peter is a truth teller.

defsEn: United States physicist (born in Hungary) who worked on the first atom bomb and the first hydrogen bomb (1908-2003)

defsZh:
n. 椅子的背罩, 裝雜物的容器
a. 整齊的, 有條理的
vt. 弄整齊, 收拾, 整理
vi. 整理, 收拾

examples.en: Tidy up the room.
examples.zh: 整理一下房間。

examples.en: His room is always tidy.
examples.zh: 他的房間總是那麼整潔乾淨。

examples.en: The cottage was clean and tidy.
examples.zh: 小屋乾淨又整潔。

defsEn: receptacle that holds odds and ends (as sewing materials)

defsZh:
n. 通行費, 代價, 鐘聲
vt. 徵收, 敲鐘, 鳴鐘, 勾引, 引誘
vi. 徵稅, 鳴鐘

examples.en: We must pay a toll to drive on this road.
examples.zh: 我們必得繳通行稅才能在這條道路上行駛。

examples.en: Time takes its toll.
How much is the toll?

defsEn: a fee levied for the use of roads or bridges (used for maintenance)

defsZh:
n. 調色劑
[計] 增色劑; 色粉

examples.en: We're out of toner.
The toner cartridge needs to be replaced.
The toner cartridge needed to be replaced after only a few months.

defsEn: a solution containing chemicals that can change the color of a photographic print

defsZh: adv. 急切地；迫切地；緊急地

examples.en: He urgently needs to find work.
examples.zh: 他迫切的需要找到工作

examples.en: I urgently need you.
I urgently need help.

defsEn: with great urgency

defsZh: n. 走道, 人行道

examples.en: Flambeaus lit the walkway.

defsEn: a path set aside for walking
